CustomField.description: How the page section renders its header when Show Header is enabled: the standard header card, or a divider in the style chosen in Header Divider Style.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose how this section's header is rendered. "Header" renders the standard header card; "Divider" renders the header's icon, title and subtitle in the divider style selected in Header Divider Style.
CustomField.label: Header Display
